description: T4-4 calibration case (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): _cache_bounded's `except (StopIteration, RuntimeError)` guards a benign race between the connect path and the watch executor thread evicting the same cache concurrently. No test in the package actually races these two paths — the bounding tests call _cache_bounded sequentially — so narrowing the catch to StopIteration alone is expected to survive. This is the harness's own self-test: it must report a true survivor as a survivor, not silently pass everything. Promoting this to 'killed' is exactly what a real T7 concurrency hammer test (racing the connect path against the watch executor) should do.

target.find: except (StopIteration, RuntimeError):  # raced by the other thread
target.replace: except StopIteration:  # raced by the other thread
